etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: From Latin inarticulatus and from in- +‎ articulate. See -ate (adjective-forming suffix).
senses: (of speech) Not articulated in normal words.

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
paragraphs: From the substantivation of the above adjective through the associated taxon's name (Inarticulata). Used by contrast with Articulata.
senses: (zoology, obsolete) An animal belonging to the subphylum Inarticulata.
